adaptive_geometry_assets.scope: Refine conforming paired egg surfaces near fixed CAD contact anchors with unchanged shell parameters.
adaptive_geometry_assets.limitations: Surface bisection and radial projection generate conforming CAD approximations; paired polyhedron vertices use identical midpoint prolongation without projection. Mesh marking anchors/radius are numerical choices and do not constrain collision locations or change any physical contact footprint, law or force. Global CAD approximation outside marked caps remains at its seed level. Geometry and represented mass change explicitly at fixed density; two thickness layers remain. All six original physical initializer points are retained. Geometry identity and small local elements do not establish stress/contact convergence, model/feedback accuracy, complete application/history or warmed cost.

cancelled_adaptive_build.scope: Post-termination observation of a cancelled adaptive-geometry build, not a producer completion record
cancelled_adaptive_build.decision_reason: Fixed refinement rounds produced108336 tetrahedra by the second requested snapshot and observed40GB resident memory; future rounds would over-refine below the useful intended edge scale. Replace round count with explicit physical edge-length targets.

The fixed polyhedron still has47.22% tensor/21.54% energy tail changes. Adaptive meshes qualify geometry/edge targets only, not contact accuracy. Full application, physical/contact/geometry/regularization tails, models/feedback and verified warmed costs remain required.
